results.name: How Do Etsy’s Listing Image Requirements Apply to My Listings?
results.title: How Do Etsy’s Listing Image Requirements Apply to My Listings?
results.body:
Listing images should accurately represent the items you're selling so buyers know what to expect when they make a purchase.

Etsy requires at least one unedited photo for most items. For other images, you can use photo editing tools, including AI, as long as your images accurately represent what buyers will receive.

Learn more about Listing Image Requirements.

Jump to a section:

  • What counts as an unedited photo?
  • Does every listing photo need to be unedited?
  • Can I use AI to edit my listing photos?
  • What is Etsy’s policy on AI-generated art or products?
  • What if I sell digital downloads or personalized items?
  • What happens if Etsy detects AI-generated images when I’m creating a listing?
  • What happens if someone reports my listing for potentially misusing AI?

What counts as an unedited photo?

An unedited photo should show the actual item against a real background and must not be edited or changed in any way. Some exceptions may apply depending on the types of items you sell. All your listing photos must accurately represent what the buyer will receive. Outside of your required unedited photo, you can use photo-editing tools, including AI, to adjust lighting or color, crop or resize images, or change backgrounds, as long as those edits don’t make the item appear different.

Does every listing photo need to be unedited?

For most items, you only need at least one real, unedited photo of your item against a real background. You can use photo editing tools in your other listing photos, as long as the edits don't misrepresent what buyers will receive.

Make your first listing photo the clearest, most realistic representation of the item buyers will receive. Because it’s the first image buyers see, take extra care to make sure it accurately represents your item and isn’t misleading.

Can I use AI to edit my listing photos?

Apart from your unedited photo, you can use AI-assisted tools to crop or resize images, adjust lighting or color, or change backgrounds. These edits are allowed as long as they accurately represent your item. Don’t use AI to hide damage or change an item's appearance in a way that could mislead buyers.

What is Etsy’s policy on AI-generated art or products?

Etsy has long supported new technologies that help people bring their ideas to life, as long as human creativity remains central to the process. That's why we allow AI-generated art when sellers play a clear creative role in what they create and are transparent about their process. Sellers must still disclose when an item is created using AI and cannot misrepresent AI-generated work as handmade or entirely their own creation. Learn more.

What if I sell digital downloads or personalized items?

Requirements may differ depending on what you sell:

  • Print-on-demand items: If a production partner prints your original design on a standard base product (like a t-shirt or mug), you may use a stock photo mockup, if the stock photo’s owner has authorized its use.
  • Digital downloads: If your item has a visual component, such as a printable or template, include a preview of the actual content buyers will receive. For digital items without a visual component, you may use representative imagery, including AI-generated images, as long as it doesn't mislead buyers about what they’re purchasing.
  • Customized or made-to-order items: For customized items you make yourself, use photos of real, finished items you’ve made in the past to help buyers see the quality of your work.
  • Craft patterns, recipes, seeds, or similar items: Include at least one real, unedited photo of something made using your product. AI-generated images cannot be the only images used to show the finished result.

Learn more about requirements for specific item types.

What happens if Etsy detects AI-generated images when I’m creating a listing?

If AI-generated images are detected when you create a listing, we will provide tips to help you accurately represent your item and meet our photo expectations.

What happens if someone reports my listing for potentially misusing AI?

In the beginning, these reports will help us better understand how buyers perceive potential AI misuse and won’t result in immediate enforcement action. We’ll continue investing in detection and enforcement tools as we learn more about how AI is being used across Etsy.

results.name: How to Add a Text Alternative to Your Listing Images
results.title: How to Add a Text Alternative to Your Listing Images
results.body:
Etsy might add alt text to US seller’s listing images to make them more accessible to users with disabilities. Images that already have alt text added will not be altered by Etsy. Alt text added by Etsy can be edited at any time.

Text alternative (or “alt text”) provides an image description to buyers who can’t see what you’re showing in your listing images. If your default shop language is set to English, you can add an image description for each of your listing images so that your content is accessible to blind and low-vision individuals.

These descriptions don’t appear visually on the page. Adding a text alternative to your listing images also means that search engines outside of Etsy can read your listing images and might also positively impact your listings’ SEO (Search Engine Optimization).

To edit the text alternative of your listing images on Etsy.com:

  1. Sign in to Etsy.com and go to Shop Manager.
  2. Select Listings.
  3. Select a listing.
  4. Select the photo you want to add alternative text to.
  5. In the Alt text section, describe your listing’s image in detail.
  6. Choose Apply.

You can add a description for as many images as you want.

To edit the text alternative of your listing images on the Etsy Seller app: 

  1. Sign in to the Etsy Seller app and go to Listings. 
  2. Select a listing. 
  3. In the Listing tab, select the pencil icon in the Photo and video section. 
  4. Select the Alt text icon. 
  5. Choose the image you want to add alt text to.  
  6. Describe your listing’s image in detail.
  7. Choose Save.

How to write a great image description

Follow these best practices to describe your images in text alternatives:

  • Describe the item’s details: what it looks like, the texture, the scale in relation to other items in your photograph.
  • Think about what buyers would lose out on if your images didn’t load on the page.
  • Keep the description concise: up to 250 characters.

Examples of text alternative


Photo by MijMojDesign

Text alternative: Watch display holder rests on a table, made of a long, wooden block base with 3 thick round columns sticking up enough for a watch band to sit sideways. Customizable text etched into the block base. Watch dial etched into top of the middle column.


Photo by AleishlaLopez

Text alternative: Earrings shaped like tall, thin arches hang far down the model’s neck. Between the arch columns hang a string of small mother of pearl droplets. The pearl droplets are free-hanging and are attached with metal links that match the arch. 

How do I describe size charts?

Describe the sizing chart image in as much detail as possible. An alternate method to include sizing charts in your listing is to put sizing charts in your listing description.

What happens if I don’t add text alternatives to my images?

If you don’t provide a text alternative to describe an image, Etsy will automatically add a description to your listing using AI generated text. If you don’t want Etsy to automatically add alt text to your listing images, manually add your own alt text to your listings.

Should I add text alternatives to all of my images?

It is especially beneficial to describe different views, details, or variations of your listing. If you provide different descriptions, each image will have different alt text for blind and low vision individuals to further understand what each of your images is showing.

What impacts my SEO?

Adding your shop name, listing title, listing description, or other attributes (tags, SKUs, etc.) to the alt text won’t be an additional benefit to your listing’s SEO as these items are already part of your shop or listing pages. Alt text is used to describe the photo for someone who cannot see it – this can include search engine bots. Learn more about how you can use SEO for your shop.

results.name: What Can I Sell on Etsy?
results.title: What Can I Sell on Etsy?
results.body:
The Etsy marketplace connects people looking for unique goods with independent sellers around the world. Everything listed for sale on Etsy must either be made, designed, handpicked or sourced by you. All items sold on Etsy must also follow our Prohibited Items Policy.

It is your responsibility to make sure your shop and its items are in compliance with Etsy's policies. The images you use in your listings must also comply with our Listing Image Requirements. Before buying or selling on Etsy, please review our Terms of Use.

Reselling mass-produced items is not allowed on Etsy. We allow limited exceptions for creative items that are handpicked or sourced by sellers. Learn more about what is allowed.

Learn more about Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Jump to a section:

  • Made by a seller
  • Designed by a seller
  • Handpicked by a seller
  • Sourced by a seller
  • Prohibited items
  • AI-generated content
  • Listings that violate Etsy's Intellectual Property Policy
  • Services or rentals
  • Metaphysical services or items
  • What happens if I find a listing that violates Etsy's policies?

Made by a seller

Items that fall under "Made by a seller" are physical items that are made by you, the seller.

Any items made by you, the seller, must:

  • Be physically made by hand, or produced using computerized tools like a 3D printer, CNC or Cricut machine
  • Only include handcrafted items, hand altered items, hand assembled items or items produced using computerized tools
  • Use your own photographs in your listings

Read Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Can I resell handmade items?

Reselling is not allowed in the Handmade category on Etsy. Reselling on Etsy means listing an item as handmade when you, the seller, weren’t involved in designing or making that item. Learn more about reselling on Etsy. 

Designed by a seller

As a seller, you can offer your original design as a digital download, or use a third party to produce or print your design onto a physical item. This category also includes seller-prompted AI creations. 

Digital items listed in your store must be made and/or designed by you, the seller. Digital items can either be premade files, or files you custom make and deliver to the buyer after purchase. 

Learn more about how to manage digital listings. 

Seller-prompted AI creations must disclose the use of AI. 

If you work with a production partner, you must disclose that production partner in your relevant listings.

Handpicked by a seller

Items that fall under "Handpicked by a seller" include vintage items that are at least 20 years old, items from nature, and certain collections of items that a seller selected and curated for sale.

Learn more about selling items curated by you in Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Sourced by a seller

Items that fall under "Sourced by a seller" enable buyer creativity, like craft supplies, party decorations and items personalized with a buyer's unique text or image.

Learn more about what can be sold in this category in Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Prohibited items

Several types of items are prohibited from being sold on Etsy, including:

  • Alcohol, tobacco, drugs, drug paraphernalia, and medical drugs
  • Certain animal products and human remains
  • Dangerous items, including hazardous materials, recalled items, and weapons
  • Hate items, including items that promote, support, or glorify hatred
  • Illegal items, items promoting illegal activity, and highly regulated items
  • Internationally regulated items
  • Pornography and mature content
  • Violent items, including items that promote, support, or glorify violence

Learn more about prohibited items.

AI-generated content

Etsy allows sellers to use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to create certain items, as long as they contribute their own creative input and follow Etsy’s policies. Sellers must disclose within their listing description if an item is created with the use of AI.

Sellers are allowed to use their original prompts in combination with AI tools to create the products they sell on Etsy. Permitted examples might include a fantasy scene based on a seller’s original prompt and produced by an AI generator, or a custom portrait of a buyer’s pet generated using AI tools. 

Some forms of AI-generated content are not allowed on Etsy, including:

  • Bot-generated content
  • AI-generated functional instructions, such as craft patterns, recipes, and instructions
  • AI prompt bundles

Learn more about Etsy’s stance on AI creations.

Listings that violate Etsy's Intellectual Property Policy

As a venue, Etsy isn’t in a position to offer legal advice or determine whether your shop content infringes someone else’s intellectual property. 

If you're not sure if your item(s) infringe someone’s intellectual property, you can contact the intellectual property owner or consult an attorney. 

If Etsy receives proper notice of intellectual property infringement, we will comply with our policy and remove the specified material.

Services or rentals

In general, services, including rentals, are not allowed to be sold on Etsy. Only services that produce a new tangible item that meets our Seller Policies may be sold on Etsy. 

Learn more about the services that may qualify to be sold on Etsy.

Metaphysical services or items

Metaphysical services, such as reiki and spell casting, are prohibited on Etsy. With this in mind, tarot or psychic readings that include a physical or digital copy of said readings (e.g., a recording, email, or tarot spread photo) may be sold on Etsy. 

Supplies related to spell work, such as herbs, crystals, candles, and tinctures, may be sold on Etsy as long as they are not listed with metaphysical claims. 

What happens if I find a listing that violates Etsy’s policies?

You can report a listing that appears to violate our policies. Etsy may review and/or remove any listings that violate our policies.

results.name: Requirements and Best Practices for Images in Your Etsy Shop
results.title: Requirements and Best Practices for Images in Your Etsy Shop
results.body:
When uploading images to your Etsy shop, follow these guidelines:

Jump to a section:

  • File type requirements
  • Image size requirements
  • Image authenticity requirements
  • How to resize images
  • Listing image best practices

Check out our Ultimate Guide to Product Photography for image inspiration and recommendations.

If your listing contains images of minors, make sure they comply with our policy.

File type requirements

All images in your shop should be one of these file types: .jpg, .gif, .png, .svg, or .heic. These are the only image file types Etsy supports. 

Animated .gif files & transparent .png files are not supported. If a file contains transparency, the transparent parts of the image will appear black on Etsy. 

Image size requirements

Learn about the size recommendations and requirements for each type of image:

  • Listing images
  • Logo
  • Profile photo
  • Team logo
  • Order receipt banner
  • Mini shop banner
  • Big shop banner
  • Carousel banner
  • Collage banner

Sellers can get a three-month Adobe Express Premium plan trial to help create professional-looking images for your Etsy shop.

Reach out to Adobe's support team if you need any assistance using their services.

Listing images

We recommend your listing photos have a width and height of at least 2000 pixels or more. Your first listing photo should have a width and height of at least 635 pixels to avoid showing up lower in searches.

You can usually find an image’s dimensions and resolution in the image details on your phone or on your computer.

Images larger than 1MB in file size may not finish uploading, especially on a slower internet connection. If you're finding that your photo uploads are taking longer than normal, follow these troubleshooting steps.

Logo 

The recommended size for logos is 500 x 500px. Learn more about uploading a logo.

Profile photo

The recommended size for profile photos is 400 x 400px. Learn more about uploading a profile photo.

Team logo

The recommended size for team logos is 170 x 100px.

Learn more about Etsy Teams.

Order receipt banner

The minimum required size for order receipt banner photos is 760 x 100px. Learn more about uploading an order receipt banner here.

Mini shop banner

The minimum required size for mini shop banners is 1200 x 160px. The recommended size is 1600 x 213px. Learn more about uploading a mini shop banner here.

Big shop banner

The minimum required size for big shop banners is 1200 x 300px. The recommended size is 1600 x 400px.  Learn more about uploading a big shop banner here.

Carousel banner

The recommended size for carousel banners is 1200 x 300px. Learn more about uploading a carousel banner here.

Collage banner

The size recommendation depends on the number of images you want in your collage:

  • For 2 images, the minimum required size is 600 x 300px.
  • For 3 images, the minimum required size is 400 x 300px.
  • For 4 images, the minimum required size is 300 x 300px.

The carousel and collage banners are only available to sellers subscribed to Etsy Plus. Learn more about Etsy Plus.

Image authenticity requirements

Your listing images should help buyers understand exactly what they will receive:

  • All images must accurately reflect the item’s true appearance, including color, condition, scale, and materials. 
  • Your listing must include at least one unedited photo of the actual item against a real background, meaning the photo hasn’t been edited or changed in any way. Some exceptions may apply depending on the types of items you sell.
  • Outside of your required unedited photo, you can still use photo-editing tools, including AI, to adjust lighting or color, crop or resize images, or change backgrounds.
  • You can't use editing to hide flaws, conceal damage, or edit an item’s appearance to make it look different from what the buyer will receive. 
  • You can’t use images that create false expectations about what the buyer will receive. 
  • If you sell functional guides like patterns, recipes, or instructions, you’ll also need to show an actual result made using your instructions, not an AI-generated or simulated result, so buyers know what to expect.

Beyond these requirements, here are a few best practices to keep in mind when using AI in your listings:

  • Make your first listing photo the clearest, most realistic representation of the item buyers will receive. Because it’s the first image buyers see, take extra care to make sure it accurately represents your item and isn’t misleading.
  • If you use AI to edit any of your listing photos, note whether images were edited in your listing description. This gives buyers more context about how your listing images were created and helps you be transparent about your use of AI.

Learn more about these requirements and rules for print-on-demand, customized, made-to-order, digital items, and more.

How to resize images

You can find websites that help you resize images online. Use a website, Photoshop, or a similar software to resize your images.

If you decrease the size of an image, it won’t lower the resolution. However, if you increase the size of an image, you may lose resolution and pixelation may occur.

Images may appear less sharp after being uploaded due to compression of the image files. We do this in order to improve the overall performance of the page. Image sizes are optimized for mobile displays.

Color mode & profile

If your image appears in the wrong colors on Etsy.com, convert your images to sRGB using an image editing software before uploading to ensure that the colors you see on the site will match the originals. We convert images to use the sRGB color profile (CMYK color profile is for print only).

Listing image best practices

Great listing images help you convert shoppers to buyers. Follow these recommendations to optimize your listing images:

  • Image orientation
  • Image rotation
  • Listing image thumbnails
  • Tips for listing images

Image orientation

The first photo in a listing should be horizontal (landscape) or square. This ensures that the center focal point of the image appears in the cropped thumbnail views.

Your first listing photo also dictates the shape of the photos that follow. Uploading the same shape photos for all listing photos will create a more cohesive browsing experience.

Image rotation

Etsy auto-rotates listing photos, but keep in mind that this depends on information included by your camera in the image file. 

If your listing images are still uploading sideways, try using a photo editing service to rotate your images, or retake the photo while holding the camera in a different position. Remember that the orientation of your subject matter should match the orientation of the camera.

Listing image thumbnails

When creating or editing a listing, use the listing thumbnail adjustment tool to set and preview how your listing image may look in different places across Etsy. Make sure that your thumbnail images have enough of a border that they can be cropped to square, portrait, and landscape thumbnails without losing some of the product.

Our recommendations are:

  • Try to capture images of your item further back than you think you’ll need. This will give you the ability to crop in without losing parts of your item. Make sure the most important part of the item is focused in the center. 
  • Position your image so your subject is clear in all 3 views used across Etsy.
  • Avoid square crops. Upload horizontal or landscape images.

Tips for listing images

Take your original picture from a far enough vantage point where you can see the entire product with extra negative space around your product.

Taking horizontally oriented picture means you’re able to use more of the available space within the thumbnail frame. Vertical images will require more information to be cropped out. 

Use the placement tool when adding images to your listings to perform fine-tuning adjustments on what appears within your thumbnail on your listing. 

Your final image will most likely be cropped down from the original image that was initially created. Confirming the image was produced at the highest resolution would be advised to meet the minimum suggested size for listing images.

results.name: How Etsy AI Assistants Work
results.title: How Etsy AI Assistants Work
results.body:
Quick answer:

Etsy might use an AI assistant in some chat interactions to quickly answer common questions.

In this article:

  • Support assistant
  • Gifting assistant
  • Wedding assistant
  • How to get help with privacy-related concerns

Support assistant

Our support AI assistant is designed to quickly resolve the most common questions Etsy members have, such as:

  • How to resolve delivery issues
  • How to address shop listing issues
  • How to resolve a case from a buyer
  • How to get help with issuing a refund
  • How to resolve order and account issues

When you select the category relevant to your question, such as refunds, the AI assistant will scan all relevant Etsy Help Center articles and similar materials to provide you with a response.

Etsy uses a third-party provider, Sierra AI, to operate the support AI assistant. We will record, monitor, and store your conversations for purposes including support, quality assurance, security, and product improvement, as described in our Privacy Policy. Your data is only used by these providers on Etsy’s behalf for the purposes of operating the AI assistant.

You don’t need to enter any personal data to interact with our AI assistant. The AI assistant automatically categorizes customer questions into topics, such as payments, returns, refunds, or delivery status. However, for certain escalated issues, we might ask for information to authenticate your account before transferring you to a human support agent.

Etsy has taken steps to preserve your privacy in case you input personal data. If you do enter personal information in your interactions with our AI assistant, such as your name or address, that information might be stored and/or used by the service. However, no response generated by the support AI assistant will contain any personal information you enter. 

Certain direct identifiers associated with you are masked, such as your email address. Such information will be obscured or replaced with generic text so that personal data cannot be identified. 

Since customer support chats go through the privacy preserving steps discussed above, they normally won’t contain much, if any, of your personal data.

If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA) or United Kingdom, your data will not be used to improve the AI assistant or for purposes of further model training.

Information related to your experience with our customer support team, including transcripts of interactions, might be retained by Etsy for a period of 6 years after your account is closed.

If you’re a resident of the United States or Canada, we might rely on your consent where we process your data with our support AI assistant.

Please see our Privacy Policy for more information on: 

  • Why and how we use your information
  • Your rights related to correction, access, deletion, or objecting to your personal data being used for AI assistant training purposes

Gifting assistant

The gifting assistant provides gift ideas and recommendations based on user prompts and responses. From grandma’s birthday to teacher appreciation gifts, this chat with AI can help you search for listings, view listing images, and retrieve information about specific shops and listings.  

This assistant is currently only available to customers in North America in English.

Etsy uses third-party providers, including Google Gemini, to operate this AI assistant. Your data is only used by these providers on Etsy’s behalf for the purposes of operating the AI assistant. Information related to your experience, including chat history and transcripts, may be retained by Etsy for 14 days. 

We use your responses to personalize your experience, gather recommendations, and other purposes that you can read about in our Privacy Policy.

Wedding assistant

The wedding assistant provides wedding ideas and recommendations based on user prompts and responses. From invitation inspiration, to trendy favors, to bridesmaids’ gift ideas, this chat with AI can help you search for listings, view listing images, and retrieve information about specific shops and listings.  

This assistant is currently only available to customers in North America in English.

Etsy uses third-party providers, including Google Gemini, to operate this AI assistant. Your data is only used by these providers on Etsy’s behalf for the purposes of operating the AI assistant. Information related to your experience, including chat history and transcripts, may be retained by Etsy for 14 days. 

We use your responses to personalize your experience, gather recommendations, and other purposes that you can read about in our Privacy Policy.

How to get help with privacy-related concerns

In certain countries, you may have the right to raise privacy-related questions or complaints regarding the processing of personal information in connection with AI assistants. 

If you have additional questions:

  • Select Contact Support below to get in touch with our support team.
  • Send an email to Etsy's Data Protection Officer at dpo@etsy.com.
  • Write to us at the contact details outlined in our Privacy Policy.

results.name: How to Protect Listing Images
results.title: How to Protect Listing Images
results.body:
Any time you upload a photo publicly to the Internet, it comes with a risk. To help protect your images, we recommend following these tips.

  • If you are selling 2D prints or original artwork, you can use photos of the actual print or work, instead of the digital file or a close-up image. For example, you could use a photo of your print hanging on a wall.

  • Upload images that are around 1500 pixels wide. This creates an image large enough to view without blurring, but small enough that a viewer won't be able to save a larger, higher quality file.

  • Incorporate your brand into your images. While some sellers use watermarks, we generally wouldn’t recommend them. Using watermarks makes photos unsuitable for features within Etsy (like Etsy Finds emails), and ineligible for off-site advertising programs like Google Shopping. Instead of watermarking, if you have a brand associated with your shop — whether it's a logo, a specific font for your shop name, or a packaging style — try including it within your listing image (but not as an overlay). This way everyone will know who made the item.

results.name: Etsy Plus: Advanced Shop Customization
results.title: Etsy Plus: Advanced Shop Customization
results.body:
Sellers subscribed to Etsy Plus can take their shop to the next level with advanced shop customization. Etsy Plus subscribers get access to exclusive, customized layouts for their shop’s banner and featured listing area.

Jump to a section:
  • Customize your banners
  • Feature your listings
  • Customize your shop's color
  • Unsubscribe from Etsy Plus

Customize your banners

All sellers have the option to set a mini or big banner, but there are additional exclusive options for Etsy Plus subscribers. 

Carousel banner

Add up to 4 different images for shoppers to scroll through. You can also link banner images to a specific listing or shop section. 

Each image must be sized to a minimum of 1200 x 300px. 

Collage banner

Create a customized banner using 2, 3, or 4 different images.

  • For 2 images, images must be sized to a minimum of 600 x 300px.
  • For 3 images, images must be sized to a minimum of 400 x 300px.
  • For 4 images, images must be sized to a minimum of 300 x 300px.

  1. On Etsy.com, go to Shop Manager. 
  2. Go to Sales channels. 
  3. Select the pencil icon next to your Etsy shop to edit your Shop Home. 
  4. Select the plus symbol next to Banner. 
  5. Choose the layout you want from the list. 
  6. Select Add an image and choose images you wish to add, or drag and drop the images directly into the space. 
  7. Select Save when finished.

  1. On Etsy.com, go to Shop Manager. 
  2. Go to Sales channels. 
  3. Select the pencil icon next to your Etsy shop to edit your Shop Home. 
  4. Select the pencil icon where your banner is located, at the top of your Shop Home.
  5. Select the trash can to remove an image. To add an image, select Add an image or drag and drop the image directly into the space.
  6. If you wish to switch to a different layout, select Change layout.
  7. Select Save when finished.

After choosing a layout and adding images, the following options are available in the top right when applicable:

  • Crosshair: Select to reposition the image by clicking and dragging it.
  • Link: When applicable, you can add a link to a listing page or link to a shop section to your image. You can also add a description for the link, which will be included in the bottom right of the image.
  • Trash can: Select to delete the image.

Depending on the number, size, and resolution of the image(s), along with your internet speed, upload times may vary.

Upload your images in the order you’d like them to appear. It’s not possible to click and drag to reorganize the images at this time.

Feature your listings

The Featured area is a space to showcase listings you want shoppers to see when they visit your Shop Home. All sellers have the option to feature 4 listings or shop sections all sized the same.
Sellers subscribed to Etsy Plus also have a mixed grid option. The mixed grid features 1 large listing or shop section with 4 smaller items or shop sections to the right.

  1. On Etsy.com, go to Shop Manager. 
  2. Go to Sales channels. 
  3. Select the pencil icon next to your Etsy shop to edit your Shop Home. 
  4. Select the plus symbol next to Featured area.
  5. Select Standard grid or Mixed grid from the menu. 
  6. Etsy pulls your most recent listings. Select Edit queue to add, delete or rearrange listings. Select Done when finished.
  7. Select Save when finished.

  1. Select the pencil icon in the lower right corner of your Featured area.
  2. Select Change layout to switch layouts.
  3. Select Edit queue to add, delete or rearrange listings. Select Done when finished.
  4. Select Save when finished.

You can also select the star symbol on a listing in your Listing Manager to add or remove it as a featured listing.

Customize your shop's color

As an Etsy Plus subscriber, you can select a custom color theme for your shop information banner and your About section. 

At this time, you can only choose from options generated using colors in your image banner and shop icon. This is so your color theme complements the rest of your Shop Home and meets accessibility requirements. 

This customization can only be completed on your desktop browser, but is visible to buyers when they visit your Etsy shop on desktop and mobile web browsers. 

  1. On Etsy.com, go to Shop Manager. 
  2. Go to Sales channels. 
  3. Select the pencil icon next to your Etsy shop to edit your Shop Home. 
  4. Select the pencil icon under Color theme.
  5. Select the color you wish to add to your Shop Home from the options provided.
  6. Select Save.

If you’re not an Etsy Plus subscriber, you must upgrade to Etsy Plus in order to save your color customization. Select Save to be prompted to sign up for Etsy Plus without losing your edit.

Unsubscribe from Etsy Plus

If you cancel your Etsy Plus subscription, any shop customization you’ve added that’s available only under Etsy Plus will be removed at the end of your subscription cycle. Your shop banner and featured items will default to standard options.

Images uploaded for advanced shop customization will not be saved in the event that you cancel your Etsy Plus subscription and then subscribe again in the future.

results.title: How to Use Etsy’s US Estimated Tariffs Calculator
results.body:
Quick Answer

You can use the US estimated tariffs calculator when creating or editing listings to estimate US duties and taxes and identify potential HS codes. Use these estimates to help inform your pricing for items being shipped to the US and ship with Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) to help buyers avoid surprises at delivery.

The US estimated tariffs calculator can help you understand potential duties and taxes for your items being shipped to the US. The estimated tariffs calculator is powered by Zonos, a third party partner, and results are based on the information you provide. Etsy does not guarantee the accuracy or reliability of these estimates. You should always validate for accuracy. 

Estimated tariff costs are provided as a guideline only and may not match the final amount charged.

Stay up to date with Etsy’s latest guidance as global trade requirements continue to evolve.

Jump to a section:

  • How do I use the US estimated tariffs calculator?
  • How should I use these estimates?
  • What should I include in my item description?
  • What is an HS code?

How do I use the US estimated tariffs calculator?

The calculator is available to sellers outside the US for listings with a shipping profile that includes the US. It’s currently unavailable for listings with price variations.

To calculate estimated US tariff costs on Etsy.com: 

  1. Sign in and go to Shop Manager.
  2. Select Listings. Choose the listing you wish to edit or create a new one.
  3. Go to Price and inventory. 
  4. Under Add estimated US tariff cost, select Get started.
  5. Enter your item’s price and country of origin, then enter either a brief description of your item or its HS code. Select Continue.
  6. If you entered an item description, review the suggested HS codes and select the one that best matches your item.
  7. Choose a new price with estimated tariffs included. 
  8. Select Update US price to instantly add it to your listing.

How should I use these estimates?

You can use the estimates from the calculator to factor estimated tariff costs into items’ US-specific pricing. Learn how to add US-specific pricing.

Your estimates may vary depending on whether you ship with a postal or courier service. Choosing a carrier with Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) option allows you to prepay duties up front. Learn more about DDP carriers.

These estimates reflect official government tariffs and do not include additional fees your carrier may charge, such as customs clearance, brokerage, or administrative costs. All estimates are powered by Zonos, a third party partner, and are based solely on the information you provide. Actual costs may vary.

What should I include in my item description?

To help the calculator assign the appropriate HS code, your product description in the first step of the calculator should be clear, specific, and include the details needed to classify the item. It should clearly state what the item is, what it’s made of, and, if relevant, its function or use.

Examples of good descriptions: 

  • Men’s 100% cotton short-sleeve shirt
  • Soy wax candle in glass container, 8 oz.
  • Merino wool yarn for knitting, 100g skein

Examples of descriptions to avoid:

  • Shirt
  • Luxury scented candle for cozy vibes
  • Blue yarn – soft and beautiful

What is an HS code?

An HS code (Harmonized System code) is a standardized numerical system used by customs authorities worldwide to classify products in international shipments. It helps determine the duties, taxes, and import requirements that apply to your item.

HS codes consist of 6 digits, which are globally standardized and identify the general category of a product. Many countries add additional digits to further specify products and determine exact duty rates and import regulations.

For shipments into the US, a 10-digit HTS (Harmonized Tariff Schedule) code is required to accurately calculate tariffs and complete customs entry. The estimated tariffs calculator leverages AI to help you identify HTS codes for US imports, based on the information you provide. If the HTS code surfaced by the estimated tariffs calculator doesn’t match your item, update the item details in the calculator. 

Etsy is not a customs broker and does not guarantee the accuracy or reliability of the HS/HTS codes identified by the estimated tariffs calculator. The HS/HTS codes are automatically generated by Zonos, a third party partner, by leveraging AI, and results are based solely on the information you provide. You are solely responsible for the accuracy of all information you provide on customs forms and to customs authorities.

results.title: Newly Crafted: Etsy Updates for Your Shop
results.body:
We know you want tools that save time, simplify your day-to-day tasks, and make it easier to grow with confidence—and we’re continually improving Etsy to support those needs.

This page highlights recent features, tools, and improvements for sellers. It’s updated periodically to give you a quick overview of what’s new. Some updates may not be listed here. For more information on what’s new at Etsy, check Etsy News, the Etsy Forums and Site Updates in the Seller Handbook.

Jump to a section:

  • September 2026
  • June 2026
  • March 2026

September 2026

Updates to help make your shop easier to run

More ways to create and manage listings

We’ve been improving the listing experience to help you spend less time on setup, collect the information you need from buyers, and manage your listings more easily. Updates include:

  • Create listings faster with the quick list form: Spend less time on repetitive setup while creating your listing. We’re testing a new form that suggests titles, tags, attributes, and more for your review and edits based on the photos and descriptions you provide. We’re testing this feature with a limited number of sellers and gradually expanding access.
  • Get more control over custom options: Create and manage personalized listings more easily with improvements to custom options fields (formerly called personalization). Charge for personalized text, reuse custom options across listings, make bulk changes, and manage custom options on the web or in the Etsy Seller app.
  • Add a third variation: Add up to three distinct variations, like size, color, and style, to make choices clearer for buyers and reduce the need for follow-up messages or custom instructions.

Create and update listings

 

Shared access to your shop

As your shop grows, you might get help from a family member, business partner, or seasonal assistant. We’ve heard from sellers that you want a better way to share the work of running your shop, so we built shared access with that feedback in mind. 

Invite team members to sign in with their own Etsy accounts so they can help manage your shop while you keep control of your account and sensitive financial information.

Learn more

 

A clearer view of your finances

We’ve updated your payment account to give you a clearer view of your finances, from sale to payout, without the extra digging. You can now:

  • See a detailed breakdown of your balances: Your payment account now separates your current, pending, and total balances, and includes your deposit status. This helps you quickly see what's available now, what’s still processing, and whether anything needs your attention before your next payout.
  • Track fees and earnings together: Sale-related fees stay grouped with the earnings from that sale instead of being deducted right away, giving you a clearer view of what you'll receive from each order.
  • [Coming soon] Find transaction statuses faster: Your transaction history will be organized into total, current, and pending tabs, so you can quickly track the status of your transactions.
  • [Coming soon] Understand your sales at a glance: Each sale in your transaction history will be expandable to show a breakdown of its associated fees and other details.

Learn more

 

Expanded listing appeals

If you believe a listing was removed in error, an appeal gives you the opportunity to ask Etsy to review the decision, share additional context with our team, and potentially restore your listing. 

We’re expanding listing appeals across more policy areas and to more sellers. By the end of 2026, all sellers will have access to appeals across most policy areas. 

Before creating a replacement listing for a removed item, review your appeal options on the Policy Violations page.

Review your appeal options

 

Easier Etsy Ads management

Managing a large Etsy Ads catalog is getting easier. If you advertise a large number of listings with Etsy Ads, you can now use ad groups to organize them around what matters to your business, like best-selling or new listings.

Add multiple listings to an ad group at once, then filter by group to manage and track their performance in one place.

Manage your ads

 

Ongoing improvements to the Community Hub

We're continuing to improve the Community Hub based on seller feedback, including usability updates and platform enhancements. Recent changes are outlined in the Community Hub Release Notes. We encourage you to continue sharing your feedback about the Hub through our survey.

View release notes

 

Updates to support your shop's growth

New ways to understand your shop and plan what’s next

We’ve been improving your stats and insights tools to help you understand what’s happening in your shop, learn more about what buyers want, and decide where to focus next. Here’s what’s new:

  • Get faster, more dependable shop stats: We’ve made improvements so your stats load faster, traffic data refreshes sooner, and you can more reliably access your full history of stats, even if your shop has a high volume of data.
  • Compare your key metrics side by side: We’re introducing new graphs in your shop stats that let you compare visits, orders, conversion rate, and revenue over the same time period, making it easier to spot changes and trends. This feature is rolling out gradually, so availability may vary as we expand access to more sellers.
  • Explore personalized recommendations in Marketplace Insights: See search terms that are relevant to your shop and frequently searched by buyers. Use these recommendations to connect your existing inventory to what buyers are searching for or get ideas for new listings you might add. This feature is currently being tested and may not be available to all sellers.

  • Dig deeper with Stats assistant: We’re expanding the beta of our AI-powered Stats assistant, which uses your shop data to provide personalized answers to questions about your stats. Ask what may be behind a slowdown in sales, explore what’s working well, or get suggestions on where you might focus next as you grow your shop. Don’t have access yet? Let us know if you’re interested in trying the expanded beta.

     

More ways for shoppers to discover your shop

We’re introducing new shopping experiences designed to help buyers discover relevant items and learn more about the sellers behind them. Updates include:

  • More local discovery: New search options let shoppers find items that ship from their area, including a Ships from [Country/City] filter and a Support makers near you option that appears when searching on Etsy.com desktop–making it easier for local shoppers to discover your shop and listings. 

  • A closer look at your shop in search: Enhanced seller previews–including your name, shop name, Etsy tenure, sales, and shop location–give buyers more context about who you are and what you make, right from search results.

     

A new way for buyers to enjoy digital items after checkout

We’re testing an experience that lets buyers turn eligible digital purchases into physical prints, sold, printed, and fulfilled by a third-party print-on-demand provider, on Etsy. 

After purchasing select digital items, buyers can choose from available print options and complete a separate checkout for the physical item. You won’t be responsible for producing or shipping the order.

The goal is to make it easier for buyers to enjoy your digital designs, without adding fulfillment work for you.

Eligible sellers are included in this test automatically. You can opt out any time. 

Updates to help make your shop easier to run

Expanded Etsy Purchase Protection coverage

Based on seller feedback, we’ve updated Etsy Purchase Protection to give you clearer expectations and stronger support when issues happen outside your control. Changes include: 

  • Coverage up to $250 USD for eligible orders, even when the order total is higher
  • Refreshed eligibility guidance
  • More human review for complex cases

Learn more

 

Detailed policy violation information

We've added more detailed information to the Policy violations page so you can better understand why a listing may have violated Etsy policies. With clearer explanations and additional context, you can make informed updates to get your listings back on track and better understand how to stay compliant with Etsy's policies going forward.

Learn more

 

Tariffs estimator

We've added a tariffs estimator in the listing form’s Price and inventory section to help you plan pricing for US buyers with more confidence. The tool lets you estimate potential tariff costs, compare shipping options, and review possible HS codes without leaving Shop Manager. By bringing these resources together in one place, you can spend less time researching and make more informed pricing decisions.

Learn more

 

New requirements for US-bound orders

To help create a more consistent and reliable experience, we’re updating our Seller House Rules for orders shipped to the US. Starting July 9, sellers outside of the US will need to account for all of their costs, including duties and import fees, to US buyers upfront in their pricing and ship with Delivery Duty Paid (DDP). If orders are shipped without duties prepaid, they will no longer qualify for Etsy Purchase Protection.

Learn more

 

Etsy Seller app updates

Updates to the Etsy Seller app help you take care of more shop tasks in one place, so you can keep orders moving and stay on top of your shop. New features include:

  • Shipping label scanner: Use your phone's camera to scan the barcode on a shipping label purchased on Etsy and instantly open the matching order on the app, helping you spend less time searching and more time fulfilling orders.
  • Refunds: Issue full or partial refunds directly from the Etsy Seller app. Before submitting a refund, you'll see a breakdown of how it affects the order, helping you make informed decisions.
  • More detailed order views: Switch to a detailed order view to see key information at a glance, including gifting details, country-specific tax information, and buyer notes. You can also message buyers, add notes, make updates, and print order details directly from the order page, helping you manage orders and buyer communication from one place.

Download the app

 

More quick actions in Messages

New tools in Messages help you resolve buyer issues faster. You can now more easily create return and replacement labels while in a conversation, view more detailed delivery information, and use suggested message drafts to quickly update buyers on their delivery status. Some of these features are also beginning to roll out in the Etsy Seller app.

Check your messages

 

Listing thumbnail previews

You can now preview listing thumbnails before publishing, making it easier to see how your photos will appear across Etsy. By spotting cropping issues before a listing goes live, you can optimize your images for discovery and help buyers get a better first impression of your items.

Preview your thumbnails

 

Custom options for personalized orders

We've improved custom options to help you collect personalization details before an order is placed. If you've used personalization in the past, you'll now find these settings under custom options in the listing form. Gathering information upfront can reduce follow-up messages, help prevent misunderstandings, and keep personalized orders moving smoothly from purchase to fulfillment.

Add custom options

 

Two videos per listing

You can now add a second video to your listings on your desktop or mobile browser, giving buyers more opportunities to understand what makes your item unique before they purchase. Use multiple videos to showcase details, demonstrate how an item is used, or share how it's made. More context can help buyers shop with confidence and make more informed purchase decisions.

Add videos

 

Refreshed look for seller tools

You may notice visual updates across Shop Manager and the Etsy Seller app, including refreshed icons, typography, and colors. These updates create a more consistent experience across Etsy's seller tools and lay the groundwork for future improvements.

 

Ongoing improvements to the Community Hub

We're actively improving the Community Hub based on seller feedback, with ongoing usability updates and platform enhancements. Recent changes are outlined in the Community Hub Release Notes. We encourage you to continue sharing your feedback about the Hub through our survey.

View release notes

 

Updates to support your shop's growth

AI-powered tools built to support sellers

Your creativity is what makes Etsy unique. We’re continuing to invest in AI-powered tools designed to help you better understand your shop, save time, and make informed decisions so you can focus on creating and growing your business.

Recent updates include:

  • Shop stats summaries: We're testing AI-powered key takeaways in Shop Stats that highlight trends in your performance data and factors that may be influencing results. This feature is rolling out gradually, so availability may vary as we expand access to more sellers.
  • Expanded AI-powered support: Through the support chat experience, quickly get answers to common account, payments, marketing, and listing questions, or find relevant Help Center resources. As part of our ongoing investment in seller support, support chat helps you get answers faster and allows our support team to focus on more complex issues when you need hands-on assistance.
  • Attribute suggestions for listings: Etsy now suggests attributes based on listing details, such as category, description, and the featured image you've already entered, helping you create more complete listings more quickly and provide buyers with clearer product information.
  • Stats assistant: We're testing a new stats assistant tool designed to make it easier to understand your shop performance and get personalized suggestions for your shop right from Shop Manager. You can ask the AI-powered stats assistant questions about your performance and get insight into what's working, what might need attention, and areas you could focus on next. This feature is currently being tested and may not be available to all sellers. Interested in trying the beta version of the stats assistant? Sign up to be considered for early access.

These tools are designed to help you better understand your shop, make informed decisions, and save time. Seller feedback continues to shape how we build and improve these experiences so they solve real business needs in ways that feel useful, trustworthy, and in your control.

Learn more

 

Interested shopper offers

Reach 2x more potential buyers on average with new Interested shopper offers than with other targeted offers alone.* Once set up, Etsy automatically sends offers to eligible shoppers who have engaged with your listings. By reaching interested shoppers at the right moment, you may encourage them to return to your shop and complete a purchase.

*Based on an internal analysis of Etsy visitor data across all platforms (app, mobile web, and desktop) from March 18–April 17, 2026.

Set up the offer

 

Promo code redemption controls

New redemption controls give you more flexibility when sharing promo codes publicly. Set limits on how many times a code can be redeemed or restrict buyers to a single use per code. These controls make it easier to share your codes on social media and other channels with confidence. Be sure to communicate redemption limits to buyers so they know what to expect.

Create a promo code

 

Redesigned Offsite Ads dashboard

The redesigned Offsite Ads dashboard gives you a clearer view of how Offsite Ads are contributing to shop traffic and sales. See revenue, fees, visits, top-performing channels, and listings in one place. You'll also be able to track traffic generated by Offsite Ads even when it doesn't lead directly to a purchase, helping you better understand how buyers discover your shop.

Go to your dashboard

 

Etsy Ads strategies for listings

With a $25+ daily budget, you can now choose Etsy Ads strategies for individual listings, giving you more control over how they’re promoted. Use listing-level controls to tailor your advertising strategy based on your business goals such as investing more in top performers or reducing spend on lower-priority items.

Learn more

 

New Marketplace Insights metrics and capabilities

We're testing Marketplace Insights features that can help you identify trends, understand buyer behavior, and make more informed business decisions. Updates include:

  • Extended date ranges: Analyze data across 30 days, 90 days, or 12 months to identify trends and opportunities over time.
  • Listing price ranges: See price ranges based on listings buyers have recently purchased for search terms.
  • Search conversion rate: Understand how often a search term leads to an order.

These features are currently being tested and may not be visible to all sellers.

Explore Marketplace Insights

 

Balanced review insights

We're making review highlights more balanced by showing both positive and constructive themes from buyer reviews. Giving buyers a fuller picture of customer experiences can help them make more informed decisions and build confidence in their purchases.

 

Expanded payment methods

We’ve expanded the ways buyers can pay on Etsy, making it easier for more shoppers around the world to complete their purchases using the payment methods they know and trust. New payment methods include:

  • Revolut (available in UK, France, Ireland)
  • Swish (available in Sweden)
  • TWINT (available in Switzerland)
  • Bizum (available in Spain)
  • UPI (coming soon to India)

Updates to help make your shop easier to run

Simpler shop settings

Shop settings are now grouped more intuitively to help you manage your shop confidently and create a strong first impression. There’s clearer context about how fields—like your About section, process videos, and team information—appear to buyers. This is the first phase of improvements to shop management and will roll out gradually to all sellers.

 

Faster, easier listing creation

Listing form sections are now organized more clearly, with shortcuts that help you find what you need faster. To help you save time, some fields may be prefilled based on your existing listings—review and edit them to ensure accuracy. We’ve also removed the Materials tag field since this information is already captured in the Materials attribute field. 

Learn more

 

Smarter order management in the Etsy Seller app

We’ve updated the Etsy Seller app to help you manage and fulfill orders more efficiently and deliver a more personalized experience:

  • Improved filters and sorting: Redesigned filtering and sorting tools help you find orders by status, ship-by date, destination, personalization, gift status, and more.
  • Buyer order history: View a buyer’s past orders and message history directly from the order details page to personalize your service.
  • Gift marking: If a buyer needs to mark their order as a gift after checkout, you can now make this update directly in the app.

We’re working on even more Etsy Seller app updates to simplify managing your business on the go.

Download the Etsy Seller app

 

Quick refunds and cancellations in Messages

We’re continuing to enhance Messages to make it easier to take order-related actions without leaving a conversation, saving you time and helping you resolve buyer issues faster. You can now issue refunds and cancellations from within Messages, with more quick actions coming soon.

Learn more about Messages

 

Clearer billing and payment management

We’ve refreshed the Make a payment page for a more seamless experience. Add or update your payment methods, view saved methods, and manage autobilling preferences directly without being redirected to Settings.

Learn more

 

Stable listing URLs for better discovery

Listing URLs now remain fixed after a listing is first published. Stable URLs help off-Etsy search engines find, understand, and surface your listings, so more buyers can discover them outside of Etsy. Redirects now only occur when a listing is permanently retired.

Learn more

 

Pricing transparency for UK buyers

To help sellers comply with the UK Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers (DMCC) Act, Etsy now displays the total item price, including shipping, throughout the shopping experience for UK buyers only. This creates a more transparent shopping experience.

Learn more

 

Updated review rating calculation

Ratings now reflect your full history on Etsy, while giving more weight to recent reviews. This approach gives buyers a more holistic view of your shop while ensuring your recent item quality and customer service have a stronger influence on your rating.

Learn more

 

Ongoing improvements to the Community Hub

We’re actively improving the Community Hub based on seller feedback, with ongoing usability updates and platform enhancements. Recent changes are outlined in the Community Hub Release Notes. Some features are only available when logged in—sign in to explore the full experience. We encourage you to continue sharing your feedback about the Hub in this survey.

View release notes

 

Updates to support your shop’s growth

More ways to get discovered with AI shopping

Buyers in the US can now discover and/or purchase eligible Etsy items within AI platforms where they’re already searching and shopping—like ChatGPT, the Gemini app and AI Mode in Google Search, and Microsoft Copilot. Learn how Etsy uses AI to support sellers.

Learn more

 

Enhanced search tools in Marketplace Insights

We created the Marketplace Insights tool last year to help you identify keyword opportunities and understand search trends. As we continue improving the tool, we’re testing updates to make tracking trends and refining your listings even simpler:

  • Week-over-week trends: Quickly see whether buyer interest in a search term is rising or falling week over week, so you can adjust listings or inventory based on demand.
  • Saved searches: Save up to 50 searches to easily revisit and monitor keywords over time.
  • Similar search term sorting: Sort keyword ideas by search volume or number of listings to compare opportunities.
  • Improved keyword ideas (English only): Discover more relevant and creative related keyword ideas to help you identify new search terms to target. Use thumbs up or down to help improve suggestions. 

These features are currently being tested and may not be visible to all sellers.

Learn more

 

Targeted offer performance at a glance

Performance metrics for targeted offers are now visible directly in Sales and discounts. The new table shows key data like offers sent, purchases, conversion rate, and revenue per offer, so you can see what’s working and plan your next promotion with confidence. 

 

A smoother checkout experience

We’ve improved the checkout experience to make it easier for buyers to complete their purchases. Buyer payment options have expanded to include Pay by Bank (UK), and guest buyers can now use Apple Pay directly from listing pages. We’ve also streamlined checkout navigation and payment selection.

We’re committed to regularly improving your experience with updates like these—and we’re also hard at work building new tools and features to help you grow. We’d love to hear how these updates are working for you. Let us know in a short survey.

results.name: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) for Shop and Listing Pages
results.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) for Shop and Listing Pages
results.body:
Search Engine Optimization (SEO) is a powerful process that can help improve the visibility of your shop and item listings in search engine results for sites like Google, Bing, and Yahoo.  

The ultimate goal of a search engine is to help a person find what they’re looking for, but SEO can seem complicated. Search engines frequently tweak what and how results come up in a search. There isn't a way to promise that your shop will appear at the top of a search engine results page. However, there are some best practices that you can use to help improve your shop's SEO.

Jump to a section:

  • The types of SEO on Etsy
  • How to get started
  • How to optimize Etsy shop pages
  • How to optimize Etsy listings
  • Where to learn more about SEO on Etsy

The types of SEO on Etsy

There are two primary types of SEO on Etsy that you should know about: 

  • Etsy SEO: This refers to searches on Etsy.com. Learn more in our Ultimate Guide to Etsy Search, and take a look at your shop visibility page for tips. 
  • Google SEO: This refers to searches on Google. 

While other search engines are used around the world, Google is the biggest by far. Optimizing for Google searches can unlock another audience of potential buyers who may be interested in the items you’re selling. 

In this article, we’ll focus on ways to improve your Google SEO. Generally, they’re very similar to optimizations we recommend for Etsy Search, with a few extra considerations.

How to get started

Before optimizing your shop and listing pages for Google, here are two things to consider: 

Think about what makes your product great

Offering something unique, interesting, and desirable is the first step in drawing in shoppers. Take a look at the items in your shop and consider what makes your shop and items different from everyone else's. This will come in handy as you write your shop and item descriptions.  

Learn how to create an amazing listing page. 

Think about keywords

A critical step in improving your shop's SEO is to find the best possible words to describe your shop and your items. Think like a shopper: What words would you search when looking for your products or shop? The exercise of selecting keywords is also helpful when you choose tags for your item listings, which help your items get found on Etsy search.

Get more tips about choosing keywords.

How to optimize Etsy shop pages

Four important SEO elements for your shop pages are your tagline, description, images and video, and policies. 

Your tagline appears under your shop name on your shop homepage. It can be up to 55 characters.

Use your tagline to briefly describe your shop and the items you sell. This can help Google better understand what kinds of products your shop sells. 

Use this space to highlight your experience and share your story. Go in depth about your background, creative process, and years of experience. Google likes to see your expertise and trustworthiness as a seller, and it’s important for potential buyers too. 

You can add a video and up to 5 images in the About section. Consider highlighting your workspace, process, or range of products. 

Fill out as many details as possible in the shop policies section. Include information about your shipping, payment options, returns, and exchanges. This isn’t just for SEO—shoppers will consider your return and exchange policies when looking to buy a product. 

How to optimize Etsy listings

Four important SEO elements for your listing pages are your item title, description, images, and videos. Learn how to add details to your listing. 

Below we'll explain why these elements are important and how you can make the best of them.

Your item title is used to create the page title for your listing page. Consider using less than 15 words when including the traits that make your item special. Search engines only show the first 50 to 60 characters for a page title, so include the most important traits upfront, like your item’s colors, material, and size.

Clearly describe your item at the beginning of the item title. State what the item is and include key details. Your title should sound natural, and a buyer who sees the title on Google should quickly be able to read and understand it. Learn more about guidance for listing titles.

Your listing’s URL is based on the title you enter when you first publish the listing. Once it's published, the URL won't change again, even if you edit the title later. While URL has less impact on SEO compared to listing title and other information, if you make major changes to your listing, consider creating a new listing so the URL better reflects what's being sold.

Search engines look at a page's full content. Be sure to describe your item well, providing detailed information about the item. 

Clearly describe your item in the first sentence of your description. A person should be able to read the first sentence and know exactly what you’re selling. Use keywords that you think shoppers will search to find your items, but avoid repeating the same phrases over and over again. 

Then, go in depth describing your item. Include information about the variations you sell (like materials or colors), personalization options, and more. Highlight what makes your product unique and describe its main selling points. 

Think: What would you want to know if you were considering buying the item? Provide information that answers those questions.

Images are extremely important in Google search. People use Google Images to find products, and high-quality images can also entice a user to click on your listing page. 

Add multiple product images, showing different variations of your item or ways to use it. Learn how to take great listing photos. 

Don’t forget to add descriptive alt text, or alternative text, for each image. Alt text helps describe images for people with visual impairment, and it’s also important for SEO. Accurate alt text helps Google better understand what’s in an image, which may also help your page appear in image-based searches.

When writing alt text, clearly and accurately describe what’s in the photo. Consider including information like color, texture, and material. 

You can add alt text to a listings image by hovering over the photo, then clicking on the pencil icon.

Add up to 2 videos to each listing, if possible. Not only are videos a great way to bring your products to life, but they could increase your visibility in Google. These videos may also appear in the Google Video search tab.

Learn how to add details to a listing. 

Search engines like to show results that are relevant and interesting. The number and quality of backlinks (also known as “in-bound links”) to a page can show Google that it contains helpful, interesting content. 

You want people to be writing about your shop and listings online, as well as linking to your Etsy pages. This helps search engines know that people are interested in your content.

Consider linking to your Etsy shop from your website, personal blog, or social media pages, but avoid buying link placements. Working with third-party agencies to buy and build links may affect your Google rankings negatively.  

Be sure to check out the Seller Handbook to learn more about SEO. 

 

Where to learn more about SEO on Etsy

If you have more questions about how to improve your shop's SEO:

  • Request a shop critique
